entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Deprecate DocumentFileInfo.IsGenerated #81755
  • Go to Defenition or Go to Implementation stops working abruptly or goes to dll code #81752
  • On VS2026, Refactor "Move to <filename>" silently overwrites existing file when moving types sharing the same base name. #81751

Closed

  • Extension blocks: extension method called from constructor is marked as unused #80645
    Backlog
  • FindAllReferences does not track extension members in CREF #81710
  • Enhance properties with top-level statements #81141
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11317.75 #81744

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix proposal adjuster losing edits #81759
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Upgrade integration tests to vs18 #81758
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Move package initialization off the UI thread entirely #81756
    Area-IDE
  • Move IRefactorNotifyService down to features layer #81749
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Extensions: fix RemoveUnusedMember scenarios #81754
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next
  • Fix documentation #81753
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Extensions: fix GetSymbolInfo within ExtensionMemberCrefSyntax #81722
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode, Next
  • Workaround up-to-date bug in generate-compiler-code.cs #81750
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix updating parse options via Solution.WithProjectInfo #81746
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove specialized task helper #81741
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix race in navigate-to #81745
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Add Ctrl+Alt+C keyboard shortcut to Open C# Interactive Window command #81659
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Track sourceLink and resources in deterministic key #81629
    Area-Compilers, Concept-Determinism
  • Initial support for nullable analysis for Unions #81721
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Add SDK analyzer assembly redirector #80969
    Area-IDE
  • [WIP] Consolidate ExternalAccess libraries #81593
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: check lang version for caller-unsafe declarations #81698
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Support null-conditional operator when the return value is a pointer type (including function pointers) #80694
    Area-Compilers
  • [BuildHost] Move RPC contracts to a separate assembly #81643
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Hot Reload: Temporarily disable project-level analysis #81729
  • HotReloadMSBuildWorkspace #81577
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Upgrade integration tests to vs2026 #81037
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update Azure pipeline queue names from vs2022 to vs2026 #80782
  • Unsafe evolution: implement compat mode #81701
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Handle potential null in extension lookup (#80621) #81740
  • Improve error recovery around 'scoped' modifier parsing #81636
    Area-Compilers
  • Update methods to be `async`. #81737
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81678
    Area-Infrastructure
